phase_reclaim: We see your machines. We will keep them.
phase_trench: Inside us there is no room.
The way in is the way we close.
phase_override: Hold still. We hold still too. For now.
Small machine. Small port. Small chance.
crew_unit: Your {role}'s drone flew well for us.

Take it back. We have more.
strike: Contact. Your crew pays for it.
We felt that. So did they.
shutdown: Quiet. We have never been quiet.
